$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: this app's override of the `orders::` strings (en) of the commerce service's orders module, shorter for a phone screen; gen merges it key by key over services/commerce/src/modules/orders/assets/lang/en/orders.json. Boundary: lives in the one overrides tree, src/overrides/<owner>/, mirroring the owner's own path (owner `commerce/orders`); only keys the orders module defines, its derived keys included (`actions.order.cancel.confirm` is the cancel action's confirmation), the same keys in every base locale (gen fails otherwise, and on a key the owner no longer defines). Runtime: react-native. Governing contract: ADR 0234, ADR 0192, ADR 0294 (decisions 20 and 23, as amended by programming model v3.1, AGENTS.md: the overrides tree)
